findings.description: INV-001 uses a unit rate not supported by the contract or latest approved variation.
findings.recommendation: Hold the line and verify the governing contract or approved variation order.
findings.title: Invoice unit rate is outside authorized contract tolerance

findings.description: Contract plus approved variation authority exceeds the configured project budget variance threshold.
findings.recommendation: Escalate to commercial/project controls for forecast and approved-budget reconciliation.
findings.title: Authorized contract cost exceeds BOQ budget threshold

findings.description: Cumulative invoice quantity for C30 exceeds or lacks delivery evidence.
findings.recommendation: Verify receipt with site records and hold the unmatched quantity.
findings.title: Invoice quantity does not reconcile to recorded delivery

findings.description: Cumulative invoice quantity for C30 exceeds or lacks purchase-order quantity.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile invoice quantity to an authorized purchase order before payment review.
findings.title: Invoice quantity does not reconcile to purchase orders

findings.description: Approved contract/variation scope for C30 exceeds the BOQ baseline.
findings.recommendation: Review the approved scope change against budget, forecast, and change-control evidence.
findings.title: Authorized contract quantity exceeds BOQ quantity

findings.description: INV-001 is outside the configured supplier price-history threshold for C30.
findings.recommendation: Review supplier price history and commercial justification; this signal is not proof of fraud or overcharging.
findings.title: Supplier unit rate deviates from deterministic historical median
